title: High-altitude nuclear tests burned holes in the Van Allen belt

tellings.quote: like the high altitude nuclear test they would just burn holes in the Van Allen belt

plain: The claim is that nuclear bombs set off high in the sky during the 1950s and 60s burned holes in the Van Allen belt, a zone of charged particles held around the Earth by its magnetic field. Michels says this himself, in passing and without naming a source, in an episode about a Secretary of Energy speaking on UFOs. If true, it would mean those tests changed the space around the planet itself.
